scale.multiplier: text-6xl sm:text-8xl font-black tracking-tighter text-transparent bg-clip-text bg-gradient-to-r from-cyan-400 to-green-400 drop-shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(34,211,238,0.5)]

typography.instructions_to_main_agent: Use Unbounded for main headings and brand names. Use Outfit for general UI body. CRITICAL: Use JetBrains Mono for ALL fast-changing numbers (Multiplier, balances, live bets) to prevent width-shifting jitter.

player_app.mobile_strategy: Mobile-first full-height layout. Main game area in center, sticky bottom navigation.
player_app.bottom_nav: Fixed bottom, z-50, glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#06090F]/80), border-t border-white/10. Active icon glows neon cyan.
player_app.game_area: Flex container taking remaining height. The graph should be prominent at the top/center, bet controls pinned above the bottom nav.

admin_portal.desktop_strategy: Grid Borders / Technical Look. Strict hierarchy, dense data.
admin_portal.sidebar: Fixed left, w-64, bg-[#06090F] border-r border-white/10.

layouts.spacing: Use p-4 to p-6 for mobile cards. Generous gaps (gap-6 to gap-8) between main layout sections. Dense gaps (gap-2) inside bet lists.

surfaces.game_canvas: relative overflow-hidden bg-gradient-to-b from-[#06090F] to-[#0F1423] border border-white/10 rounded-2xl

buttons.bet: w-full py-4 rounded-xl font-bold text-lg transition-all duration-200 bg-green-500 text-black hover:bg-green-400 shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(34,197,94,0.3)] hover:shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(34,197,94,0.6)] transform hover:-translate-y-1 active:translate-y-0
buttons.cashout: w-full py-4 rounded-xl font-bold text-lg transition-all duration-200 bg-cyan-500 text-black hover:bg-cyan-400 shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(6,182,212,0.3)]

visual_enhancers.crash_state: When crashed, multiplier turns text-red-500, graph stroke turns red, background flashes red/10.

animations.multiplier_tick: Use Framer Motion to animate value changes smoothly if possible, or just raw React state with JetBrains Mono to prevent jitter.
animations.plane_trail: An SVG path with stroke-dasharray animation drawing left-to-right/bottom-to-top, colored cyan.

components.chart: For the crash curve, avoid complex chart libraries. Use a simple responsive SVG `<svg>` drawing a quadratic bezier curve `<path>` driven by the current multiplier state.
components.live_players_list: Dense table/list with avatars, usernames, bet amounts, and live cashout statuses (green badge if cashed out).
components.chat: Fading top overlay or side panel in desktop. On mobile, a collapsible bottom sheet or simple text overlay over the game.

hero_background.description: Airplane lights in dark night sky, suitable for auth screen background overlay.

abstract_texture.description: Subtle green/dark abstract stripe for header or card backgrounds.

icons.instructions: Use Lucide React icons. Keep stroke-width to 1.5 or 2.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over glowing elements remains readable. Use dark text (black/slate-900) inside bright neon buttons.
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for the heavy background animations, but keep the core game curve.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: Do NOT use transparent backgrounds for the bottom nav or headers. Use heavy blur + semi-solid backgrounds.
Build the UI in JS + Tailwind. Do not use TSX since the environment is JS.

Game Curve Implementation: For the best visual, create a React component that renders an `<svg>` with a dynamic `<path>` moving from bottom-left to top-right. Add a small rocket/plane SVG or icon at the leading edge of the path.
All interactive elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="bet-button"`).
Admin and Player apps should likely share the same base styling, but Player app is mobile-first, and Admin is desktop-focused grid.
Do not implement generic placeholder gradients; use solid dark grays with 1px borders.
Apply glow effects carefully: use drop-shadow on the main multiplier text, but keep surrounding text clean and sharp.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. Always add transitions for specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add `.App { text-align: center; }`.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
Use `sonner` for toasts. Sonner component are located in `/app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.jsx` or similar.
